_comment: Edit, then apply with .\install.ps1 -Restart. Paths accept %ENVVAR%.
_WatchFileName: EXACT filename only, in steady state. Chrome dedupe variants like 'files (1).zip' are never detected live -- see README 'Why only files.zip'.
_OrphanWarnPattern: Identifies Chrome dedupe variants. Seeing one means the watcher was down when it arrived.
_ProcessOrphansOnStartup: v1.3.0. true = the startup sweep also PROCESSES dedupe orphans, oldest-first so the newest download wins collisions. false = the old behaviour, warn only. Startup only; steady-state detection stays exact-name.
_HeartbeatMinutes: v1.3.0. Writes a periodic 'alive, idle' line so a silent log proves the watcher is DEAD rather than merely idle. Bounds an unexplained death to this many minutes. 0 disables.
_tuning: StableSeconds x StableChecks = minimum quiet period before a download counts as complete.
_PollSeconds: Safety net ONLY -- detection is event-driven, so this can be long. 300s keeps idle wakeups to 12/hour. Lower it only if you distrust FileSystemWatcher.
